data.title: Novo Nordisk to Launch Wegovy Weight-Loss Pill in Sweden Next Month
data.description:
By Dominic Chopping

Novo Nordisk will launch its Wegovy weight-loss pill in Sweden on Dec. 24, the Danish drugmaker said Friday.

The once-daily pill first launched in the U.S. in early January and has seen strong uptake among Americans, with the company recently disclosing that sales in the country topped $1.4 billion in the nine months through September.

Further launches have followed, in countries including the U.K., United Arab Emirates, Germany, Mexico, Spain, France and Poland, which together saw $190 million of Wegovy pill sales in the period, with most of that coming in the third quarter.

Novo Nordisk has previously said that it expects the tablet to be available in more than 20 markets in 2027.

"The launch of the Wegovy tablet represents a major step forward for obesity care in Sweden," said Jorgen Kronborg Jungersen, chief executive of Novo Nordisk Sweden. "We see that more people become interested in treatment when a tablet is available as an option."

Prices for the pill will be comparable to the current prices for the injectable version of Wegovy, Novo said.

Swedish pharmacies will set their own retail prices for consumers.

Write to Dominic Chopping at dominic.chopping@wsj.com

data.title: Inflation Slides in France, Spain on Declining Fuel Prices — 4th Update
data.description:
By Ed Frankl and Paul Hannon

The annual rate of inflation in France and Spain fell more sharply than expected in November as fuel prices declined, while the eurozone economy grew less rapidly than previously estimated in the three months through September.

Investors expect the European Central Bank to raise its key interest rate next month for a third time since the start of the war between the U.S. and Iran. But the central bank has said it will be "data-dependent" in its policy decisions, and the latest readings from the eurozone economy point to weaker inflationary pressures.

Consumer prices in the eurozone's second-largest economy were 3.2% higher than in the same month of 2025, a lower annual rate of inflation than the 3.7% recorded in October, France's statistics office said Friday. Economists polled last week by The Wall Street Journal expected a 3.6% rate of inflation.

In Spain, figures published Friday showed the annual rate of inflation also dropped sharply in November, to 4.1% from 4.9% in October.

Oil prices have fallen since the outcome of U.S. midterm elections fueled hopes of a lasting resolution to the conflict, although they remain above prewar levels. As a result, prices of gasoline and other fuels have declined.

However, European natural gas prices remain near multiyear highs, which will keep household energy prices elevated throughout the colder winter months.

The ECB has raised its key rate twice so far this year, judging that the surge in energy prices was too great to ignore. Investors are primed for another hike before the end of the year.

The EU said last week that it expects French inflation to peak at 4.3% in the first quarter of 2027 due to further increases in energy prices and how they pass through into food and services.

Yet incoming data shows few signs of those energy costs spilling over into other parts of the economy. Services inflation in France fell in November due to a sharp decrease in prices for accommodation and transport services.

Revised figures for economic growth in the three months through September indicate that the eurozone economy has been less resilient in the face of higher energy prices than previously estimated.

The French statistics agency on Friday said the country's gross domestic product sank 0.2% in the third quarter, having previously estimated the drop at 0.1%. Consumer spending was also flat in October. Surveys of purchasing managers for November showed steady economic growth in Germany, while there was a deepening downturn in activity in France.

"A weakening labor market and growing fears of unemployment will keep households cautious. At the same time, weak demand and a lack of visibility will continue to weigh on business investment. The outlook for 2027 remains very gloomy," Charlotte de Montpellier, an economist at ING, wrote in a note to clients.

Earlier this week, Germany's statistics agency cut its estimate for third-quarter growth. Meanwhile, eurozone business sentiment slipped this month, according to separate data published Friday.

Amid those signs of weakening inflationary pressures, the ECB's own survey of 19,000 consumers between Oct. 1 and Nov. 2 yielded some concerning news for policymakers. It found that households expected prices to rise by 3.5% over the coming 12 months, up from 3.1% in September.

However, expectations may fall back in response to November's inflation figures, although the next survey won't be released until early next year and the ECB announces its policy decision on Dec. 17.

Write to Ed Frankl at edward.frankl@wsj.com and Paul Hannon at paul.hannon@wsj.com

data.title: Countries Increasingly Prioritize Own Economic, Security Interests — Market Talk
data.description: Countries are increasingly prioritizing their own economic and national security interests over global partnerships, a shift that has accelerated under the second Trump administration, Julius Baer's Yves Bonzon says. "As geopolitical tensions rise and concerns around supply-chain resilience grow, governments are placing greater emphasis on strategic autonomy, investing in domestic industries and reducing reliance on foreign suppliers," he says. For investors, this means political and geopolitical developments are likely to have a greater influence on markets than traditional economic and company fundamentals, leading to increased uncertainty and volatility, Bonzon says. (emese.bartha@wsj.com)

data.title: Gasoline margin extend losses; KPC sells December cargo
data.description:
Asia's gasoline margin fell further into negative territory on Friday amid rising supplies from China and rebuilding inventories at key trading hubs, analysts said.

The crack declined to minus $6.95 per barrel over Brent crude from minus $5.92 a day earlier.

In tenders, Kuwait Petroleum Corp. sold 34,000-35,000 tons of 93-octane non-oxygenated gasoline for loading during December 9 and 10 at a premium above $200 per ton to Middle East naphtha quotes, market participants said.

In the naphtha market, the crack fell by about $19 to $103.03 per ton over Brent crude on Friday after crude oil prices gained steam.

In spot trades, premiums for first-half January cargoes have narrowed to below $10 per ton to Japan quotes this week. South Korean and Japanese buyers surfaced for those cargoes, market players said.

NEWS

- Oil prices were on track to snap a three-week losing streak on Friday, riding four sessions of gains, as attacks on tankers in the Strait of Hormuz and Saudi energy infrastructure fanned concern over Middle East supplies.

- Iraq considers oil exports that bypass state oil marketer SOMO to be smuggling as the proceeds do not reach the state treasury, government spokesman Haider al-Aboudi told the Iraqi state news agency on Friday.

data.title: Metal wage deal should serve as example for Volkswagen, IG Metall rep says
data.description:
A hard-won wage deal in Germany's crisis-laden metal and electrical sector should serve as a blueprint for Volkswagen, which is locked in a dispute with unions over cost cuts and factory closures, a senior IG Metall representative said on Friday.

"This collective agreement ... clearly demonstrates that it is possible to secure pay rises for employees even in very difficult times," Thorsten Groeger, IG Metall's chief negotiator in talks with Volkswagen, said.

"Volkswagen should take this as an example," he added.

Volkswagen and unions met this week for a first round of crunch talks over possible salary freezes for 2027 and 2028 as well as additional job cuts, while workers in the metals industry negotiated an increase for both years.

Labour representatives at the automaker have slammed management for violating existing labour deals, saying they would only start to enter serious discussions if the company was serious about production in Germany.

"When it comes to the future, to safeguarding jobs, and to regaining trust, Volkswagen has, in fact, come empty-handed," Groeger said, adding that unless that changed there was no reason for IG Metall to make any concessions.

data.title: Most Dramatic Rate Hikes Are Past, but Era of Ultra-Low Rates Also Seen Over — Market Talk
data.description: While the most dramatic phase of interest-rate increases is now behind us, the era of ultra-low rates appears to be over, says Yves Bonzon, group chief investment officer at Julius Baer. "The return to a more normal cost of capital is reshaping investment markets and exposing important differences between private and public sector balance sheets," he says in a note. Households and corporations have generally proven more resilient than expected, but governments face mounting pressure from higher refinancing costs and rising debt burdens, he adds. "As a result, fiscal sustainability and debt management are becoming increasingly important considerations for policymakers and investors alike." Julius Baer continues to favor high-quality corporate credit and local-currency emerging market debt, "both of which benefit from comparatively stronger balance sheets." (emese.bartha@wsj.com)

Indicative Announcement on the Share Repurchase Proposed by the Chairman of the Board

The Board of Ming Yang Smart Energy Group Limited (hereinafter referred to as the "Company") received the Letter on Proposing the Share Repurchase of Ming Yang Smart Energy Group Limited from Mr. Chuanwei Zhang, the actual controller, Chairman, and Chief Executive Officer (General Manager) of the Company, on November 27, 2026. Mr. Chuanwei Zhang proposed that the Company repurchase part of its issued RMB ordinary shares (A shares) through centralized bidding via the stock trading system of the Shanghai Stock Exchange, using its own or self-raised funds. The details are as follows:

I. Basic Information of the Proposer and Proposal Date

(I) Proposer: Mr. Chuanwei Zhang, Chairman of the Board

(II) Proposal date: November 27, 2026

II. Reasons and Purposes of the Share Repurchase Proposed by the Proposer

Based on confidence in the Company's sustained and stable development in the future and recognition of the long-term investment value of the Company's shares, in light of the Company's operating conditions, financial position, and future development prospects, and to safeguard the interests of investors, especially small and medium-sized investors, enhance investor confidence, and promote the healthy and sustainable development of the Company, Mr. Chuanwei Zhang, Chairman of the Board, proposed that the Company repurchase part of its issued RMB ordinary shares (A shares) through centralized bidding via the stock trading system of the Shanghai Stock Exchange.

III. Content of the Proposal by the Proposer

(I) Type and method of repurchase: Repurchasing part of the Company's issued RMB ordinary shares (A shares) through centralized bidding via the stock trading system of the Shanghai Stock Exchange.

(II) Purposes of repurchase: To safeguard the Company's value and shareholders' rights and interests.

(III) Repurchase period: Within 3 months from the date when the Board deliberates and approves this share repurchase plan.

(IV) Repurchase price: The price of this share repurchase shall not exceed 150% of the average trading price of the Company's shares over the 30 trading days prior to the resolution of the Board approving the repurchase plan, subject to the specific repurchase plan approved by the Board.

(V) Total amount of funds for the repurchase: The total amount of funds for this repurchase shall be no less than RMB 100 million (inclusive) and no more than RMB 150 million (inclusive).

(VI) Sources of funds for the repurchase: The Company's own funds or self-raised funds.

IV. Shareholding Increase/Decrease Plans of the Proposer During the Repurchase Period

On October 30, 2026, the Company disclosed the Announcement on Share Increase Plan by the Chairman and CEO, Actual Controller, Certain Directors, Senior Officers, and Core Business Backbone of the Company. Mr. Chuanwei Zhang, the Chairman and the proposer, plans to increase his shareholding by an amount of no less than RMB 20 million, and his parties acting in concert, Director Mr. Rui Zhang (one of the actual controllers of the Company) and his close relative Director Ms. Chao Zhang, plan to increase their shareholdings by an amount of no less than RMB 2 million each. The shareholding increase plan has not yet been completed.

Mr. Chuanwei Zhang, the Chairman and the proposer, has no plan to decrease his shareholding during this repurchase period. If there is any subsequent plan to decrease his shareholding in the Company, he will timely assist the Company in fulfilling information disclosure obligations in accordance with relevant laws, regulations, normative documents, and undertakings.

V. Trading of the Company's Shares by the Proposer Within 6 Months Prior to the Proposal

Within 6 months prior to the proposal, Mr. Chuanwei Zhang, the Chairman and the proposer, and his parties acting in concert increased their shareholdings in the Company by a total of 678,500 shares. For details, please refer to the Announcement on the Progress of the Shareholding Increase by the Chairman and Chief Executive Officer, Actual Controllers, Certain Directors, Senior Officers, and Core Business Backbones of the Company.

VI. Undertakings by the Proposer

Mr. Chuanwei Zhang, the Chairman and the proposer, undertakes that he will actively promote the Board to deliberate the share repurchase matters as soon as possible, and will vote in favor of the Company's share repurchase proposal at the Board meeting.

VII. Opinions of the Board on the Share Repurchase Proposal and Subsequent Arrangements

The Company and the Board will promptly deliberate on the above matters, formulate a reasonable and feasible share repurchase plan, perform approval procedures in accordance with relevant regulations, and fulfill information disclosure obligations in a timely manner.

The above-mentioned repurchase matters are subject to consideration and approval by the Board before implementation and are still subject to uncertainties. Investors are advised to be aware of investment risks.

data.title: Axion Minerals Completes Phase 1 Fieldwork at Cranberry Creek REE Property
data.description:
Vancouver, British Columbia--(Newsfile Corp. - November 27, 2026) - Axion Minerals Corp. ("Axion" or the "Company") is pleased to announce the completion of fieldwork for its Phase 1 exploration program at the Cranberry Creek REE Property (the "Property"), located approximately 23 kilometres south of Revelstoke, British Columbia. Fieldwork was completed mid November 2026.

The program followed up on targets from the 2025 exploration work and was based on the recommended work program in the Independent Technical Report on the Cranberry Creek REE Property, effective June 3, 2026, prepared by Kristian Whitehead, P.Geo. Field activities included prospecting, geological mapping, rock sampling, soil and stream-sediment sampling, ground radiometric, magnetic and VLF (very low frequency) ground geophysical surveys, and recording field structural observations.

Phase 1 Sampling Program

The field program collected 239 primary field samples. An additional 30 quality-control samples were recorded in the sample inventory. All samples have been submitted to AGAT Labs in Calgary for preparation and analysis; analytical results are pending.

Sample categoryNumber
Rock samples36
Soil samples135
Stream-sediment samples68
Primary field samples239
Duplicate samples15
Standards9
Blanks6
Quality-control samples30
Total submitted, including quality control269

The sample totals above distinguish primary field samples from separately recorded duplicates, standards and blanks. The field observations and any portable radiometric readings are preliminary and are not laboratory assay results.

Geological and Structural Observations

Field descriptions record biotite- and muscovite-bearing gneiss and schist, together with quartzite. Local feldspar-rich bands, pegmatite veins and quartz-feldspar veins or lenses were noted within the metamorphic rocks. Rusty-brown to orange weathering and oxidation, as well as locally noted black grains of various minerals, were recorded at selected outcrops and float locations.

The mapping notes describe compositional banding and foliation in the gneiss and schist. Where measured, foliation dips range from approximately 5 degrees to 63 degrees, with variable recorded strike directions. These are surface observations; the identity of unidentified grains and the significance of the observed geological features will be evaluated with the laboratory results and further interpretation of collected data.

Next Steps

When analytical results are received, the Company plans to integrate them with the geological mapping and the 2025 exploration data to assess the follow-up targets and determine appropriate next steps for the Property. Similarly ground geophysical survey data will be processed to further refine exploration targets.

"The Phase 1 field program has expanded our geological and geochemical coverage at Cranberry Creek and generated a substantial sample set for analysis," said Christopher Hill, Chief Executive Officer of Axion Minerals Corp. "We look forward to receiving the laboratory results and integrating them with the field observations and our previous work to guide the next stage of exploration."

Cranberry Creek REE Property

The Property comprises three contiguous mineral claims covering approximately 2,673.19 hectares in the Kamloops Mining Division of British Columbia, about 23 kilometres south of Revelstoke. It is underlain principally by high-grade metamorphic rocks of the Monashee Complex, including muscovite- and biotite-rich gneiss, quartzite and schist, with local granitic and pegmatitic intrusions. Axion holds an option to acquire a 100% interest in the Property. No Mineral Resource or Mineral Reserve has been defined on the Property.

Qualified Person

The technical information in this release has been reviewed and approved by Afzaal Pirzada, P.Geo., a consultant to the Company and a Qualified Person under National Instrument 43-101.

About Axion Minerals Corp.

Axion Minerals Corp. is engaged in the business of mineral exploration and the acquisition of mineral property assets in Canada. Its objective is to locate and develop economic mineral properties of merit and to conduct its exploration program on the Cranberry Creek REE property, which is comprised of three contiguous mineral claims covering approximately 2,673.19 hectares in the Kamloops Mining Division, British Columbia.

data.title: Jensen Huang Returns To Nvidia, Musk Says 'The Mistake Has Been Corrected,' And Trump Weighs In: Mag 7 Voices This Week
data.description:
Key points:
  • Huang told employees he is "terribly sorry" and will be "a better CEO the second time around," and said he is in daily therapy.
  • Elon Musk welcomed Huang’s return and wrote, "the mistake has been corrected" in a post on X.
  • President Donald Trump said he spoke to Nvidia's board "directly and indirectly" before the vote which decided Huang’s return.

Nvidia (NVDA) reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO this week, but the board's reversal has not put congressional scrutiny to rest. Senator. Pete Ricketts (R-NE) said Huang's return to the helm of the chipmaker "doesn't excuse” him from testifying before Congress.

Huang's reinstatement came less than a week after the board had publicly stated that it had decided against bringing him back. The company is still facing questions around the board’s investigation into Huang’s affair with an alleged Chinese spy. Nvidia said it had no reason to believe national security was compromised.

Huang is scheduled for a closed-door House interview on December 1 and a public Senate Banking Committee hearing on December 3.

Here’s what Nvidia’s Huang, Tesla’s (TSLA) Elon Musk, Alphabet’s (GOOG, GOOGL) Sundar Pichai, and other tech leaders had to say this week:

Nvidia's Board Reinstates Jensen Huang After 11 Days

The vote was unanimous for Huang’s reinstatement, which came less than two weeks after his resignation. Nvidia's board said it had concluded that Huang was the “right person” to lead the company following a series of discussions with him. It added that it had consulted "senior levels of the United States government" and was satisfied with Huang's candor and ability to lead.

“Jensen is the right person to lead Nvidia."

– Harvey Jones, Chair, Nvidia

The decision reversed the board's position from November 17, when Jones told analysts it did not intend to reinstate Huang.

However, according to Bloomberg, the board made its decision without consulting interim CEO Colette Kress. In an interview with CNBC, Trump said the administration gave “assurance” that Huang did not pose a national security threat.

“I can't wait to get back to work."

– Jensen Huang, Nvidia, CEO

On his return to Nvidia, Huang said he was honored to be back in the role and grateful for his family's support. He received a standing ovation at Nvidia's headquarters and told employees he would be "a better CEO” the second time around.

"I'm terribly sorry for putting all of you through all of this."

– Jensen Huang, Nvidia, CEO

On Tuesday, Huang reportedly apologized to employees at an hour-long meeting, saying he had made very serious mistakes. According to Wired, he said his conduct violated Nvidia's code of conduct, parts of which he wrote. He also said he is in therapy every day and that the board would hold him accountable. Huang added that the board made the decision to reinstate him on its own.

Elon Musk, Donald Trump React To Jensen Huang's Return

Musk welcomed Huang's reinstatement shortly after Nvidia announced the decision.

"The mistake has been corrected."

– Elon Musk, CEO, Tesla and SpaceX

At the DealBook Summit the previous week, Musk had said there was no one who could really replace Huang and that he would consider it an honor to hire him. SpaceX also relies on Nvidia GPUs for its AI computing infrastructure.

"The Country needs Jensen's leadership at NVIDIA."

– Donald Trump, President, USA

Trump praised Nvidia's board for reinstating Huang but also said the company "should continue its thorough internal investigation into compliance with U.S. national security rules. In an interview with CNBC, he also said he spoke with board members "directly and indirectly" before the vote.

"Always an option, I guess, but I don't think it'll be necessary."

– Donald Trump, President, USA

Trump said he would consider a pardon for Huang but does not expect one to be needed. He said, "I don't think he needs to take the Fifth," and added that he is focused on the "business of chips, much more than the business of sex."

"Tip of the iceberg."

– Senator Tom Cotton (R-AR)

Senator Tom Cotton (R-AR) said Huang's return does not resolve concerns that Nvidia chips could be reaching China. Democrats in both chambers have vowed investigations, and Senate Majority Leader John Thune (R-SD) has promised action on export controls.

The Commerce Department also added Megaspeed to a blacklist that bars it from receiving Nvidia chips without a license. Megaspeed is the Singapore-based company where Alice Huang, the woman at the center of the investigation, worked.

Sundar Pichai Says Gemini Neon Set A 'Day-1 Usage Record'

Pichai said Google's latest Gemini model, Neon, recorded its strongest first-day usage on paid APIs.

"Neon set a new Day-1 usage record on our paid APIs."

– Sundar Pichai, CEO, Alphabet

He also said daily token usage on Google's Antigravity coding tool had increased 82% in the six weeks since the Argon model launched. Musk responded that the work was impressive.

Meanwhile, Microsoft’s (MSFT) Satya Nadella, Amazon’s (AMZN) Andy Jassy, Meta’s (META) Mark Zuckerberg and Apple’s (AAPL) John Ternus made no notable public remarks this week.

AAPL Stock Leads November Gains

AAPL stock is on track for a strong November, leading gains among the Magnificent 7, in a volatile month dominated by Anthropic's (ANT) record IPO and Nvidia's leadership upheaval.

The iPhone maker's market capitalization is now nearly $2 trillion larger than Microsoft's, the second-most valuable U.S. company. Nvidia dropped to third place, with a market value of roughly $3.6 trillion, on track to suffer the steepest decline among the Magnificent Seven this month.

On Stocktwits, retail sentiment around Apple improved to ‘bullish’ from ‘neutral’ territory over the past week, while sentiment around Nvidia dipped to ‘bullish’ from the ‘extremely bullish’ zone.

data.title: Trump Media to spend up to $13M courting shareholders for TAE merger approval - report
data.description:
Trump Media & Technology Group , the owner of Truth Social, expects to spend between $8M and $13M, plus additional expenses, on a shareholder solicitation campaign ahead of its proposed merger with fusion energy company TAE Technologies, the Financial Times reported.

The company has hired Alliance Advisors to persuade shareholders to support the all-stock merger, with a shareholder vote scheduled for December 14. Trump Media said reaching more than 600,000 retail shareholders represents a significant undertaking.

The proposed spending has drawn attention because routine proxy solicitation campaigns typically cost less than $1M, according to Michael Levin, a corporate governance expert cited by the report.

Alliance Advisors defended its fees, saying the amount reflects the work involved in reaching Trump Media's shareholder base and is consistent with industry standards.

The merger requires approval from a majority of Trump Media's outstanding shares to increase its authorized share capital. The company has warned shareholders that failing to vote will count as opposition to the proposal.

Directors including Donald Trump Jr. and Boris Epshteyn control 42% of the company's stock, the report pointed.

Separately, Trump Media has paid $650,000 to social-media marketing firm Outside The Box Capital, which hired online personalities to promote the company and the proposed merger.

The deal would combine Trump Media with TAE Technologies, which reported a net loss of $201M for the year ended March 2026. Trump Media shares have fallen nearly 72% so far this year.

data.title: New ECB leadership inherits a broken playbook
data.description:
By Jon Sindreu

Incoming President Pablo Hernández de Cos and his lieutenants may keep relying on consumers and traders’ inflation expectations when setting rates. But these are a poor gauge of whether policy is tight or loose and can cause errors. The next shock may force De Cos to improvise.

Full view will be published shortly.

Follow Jon Sindreu on X and LinkedIn.

CONTEXT NEWS

On November 26, euro zone countries chose Pablo Hernández de Cos to be the next president of the European Central Bank. De Cos, currently General Manager of the Bank for International Settlements, will take over when Christine Lagarde steps down on February 7 and will chair his first policy meeting on March 18. European leaders also nominated Germany's Markus Brunnermeier and France's Laurence Boone to fill the remaining two vacancies on the ECB Executive Board. They are expected to replace Chief Economist Philip Lane and head of market operations Isabel Schnabel, respectively.

data.title: Turkey's central bank suspends repo auctions in liquidity-tightening move
data.description:
Key points:
  • Net international reserves fell sharply last week
  • Central bank has hiked foreign exchange-for-lira swap auctions
  • Measures seen tightening liquidity to support lira, reserves
  • Analysts see December rate cut increasingly unlikely

By Nevzat Devranoglu

Turkey's central bank has suspended its one-week repo auctions temporarily in a move expected to push overnight interest rates towards the 39% overnight lending rate, tightening liquidity after heavy forex sales and a sharp fall in reserves.

In another step aimed at supporting lira demand, the central bank also said overnight it had raised the remuneration rate it pays on required reserves for deposits to 90% of the weighted average funding cost from 86%.

The moves come as authorities seek to contain the fallout from an investment funds crisis, which has prompted demand for foreign currency and a flight by some investors towards safer assets.

BANKING INDEX DROPPED SHARPLY

The lira was slightly weaker at 50.7875 against the dollar at 1009 GMT and at record lows. It has weakened around 2% over the past month.

Turkey's main banking index (.XBANK) fell as much as 5.6% before paring losses to 2%.

The repo move effectively shifts funding costs above the central bank's 36% policy rate. The overnight reference rate TLREF had risen to 37.87% on Thursday from 35.95% previously.

The central bank (CBRT) decision marks a significant turning point in the monetary policy outlook, according to BBVA Turkey and MENA credit strategist Tufan Comert.

"In our view, this represents more than a temporary adjustment to liquidity conditions: it signals that the CBRT's immediate priority has shifted from monetary policy normalisation to preserving exchange-rate stability, containing dollarisation pressures and protecting its remaining reserve buffers," Comert said.

Ata Yatirim deputy general manager for research, Cemal Demirtas, said the bank's recent measures amounted to implicit monetary tightening through liquidity reduction without changing the policy rate, aimed at curbing dollarisation risks and protecting the lira and foreign-exchange reserves.

Demirtas said the likelihood of an interest rate cut in December had largely disappeared, while short-term bond yields and deposit rates were likely to face upward pressure. He added that the measures could weigh on equities in the short term, but stabilising the lira and halting the rise in CDS spreads could help restore market confidence.

NET RESERVES DROPPED SHARPLY

Data on Thursday showed the central bank's net international reserves fell by $17.1 billion last week to $24.19 billion, the second-largest weekly decline on record, with reserves falling to their lowest level since May 2024.

The central bank sharply increased its daily foreign exchange-for-lira swap auctions from the usual $500 million to $2 billion on Monday, $3 billion on Tuesday, $4 billion on Wednesday and $6 billion on Thursday.

Ankara is meanwhile moving to strengthen financial oversight, appointing a new head of the banking watchdog BDDK after the resignation of Sahap Kavcioglu in connection with the funds crisis. At a press conference on the funds crisis on Thursday evening, Finance Minister Mehmet Simsek said further steps would be taken to strengthen market supervision and oversight.

Three traders told Reuters earlier this week that the central bank's forex sales had exceeded $10 billion, while net reserves excluding swaps had turned negative.

Simsek said on Thursday the central bank and government would not hesitate to use various instruments to preserve the attractiveness of the lira, while Central Bank Governor Fatih Karahan said earlier this week the bank would take a proactive, flexible and controlled approach to reserve and liquidity management.

data.title: Novo Nordisk to Launch Wegovy Weight-Loss Pill in Sweden Next Month
data.description:
By Dominic Chopping

Novo Nordisk will launch its Wegovy weight-loss pill in Sweden on Dec. 24, the Danish drugmaker said Friday.

The once-daily pill first launched in the U.S. in early January and has seen strong uptake among Americans, with the company recently disclosing that sales in the country topped $1.4 billion in the nine months through September.

Further launches have followed, in countries including the U.K., United Arab Emirates, Germany, Mexico, Spain, France and Poland, which together saw $190 million of Wegovy pill sales in the period, with most of that coming in the third quarter.

Novo Nordisk has previously said that it expects the tablet to be available in more than 20 markets in 2027.

"The launch of the Wegovy tablet represents a major step forward for obesity care in Sweden," said Jorgen Kronborg Jungersen, chief executive of Novo Nordisk Sweden. "We see that more people become interested in treatment when a tablet is available as an option."

Prices for the pill will be comparable to the current prices for the injectable version of Wegovy, Novo said.

Swedish pharmacies will set their own retail prices for consumers.

Write to Dominic Chopping at dominic.chopping@wsj.com

data.title: TSX futures rise on strength in gold, copper

  • Prices of base metal copper (HGc1) were up above 4% and recorded their biggest single-day gain since January, with stronger industrial profits in China also supporting the sentiment

  • Meanwhile, Brent crude futures rose 0.5% and were heading for weekly gains after three weeks of losses, as attacks on tankers in key Middle East waterways kept shipping risks persistent
